contexts.text: Would he not be what is called a dullard and a stock?
They assert... that in spiritual things man cannot begin, will, think, etc. anything, any more than a stock.
The wise Englishman said... Does a man conceive faith in act like a stock? Is the Church... in a stock which is then vivified?
You (therefore) regard man, as to all spiritual things... as a stock...
If (the Angels and Spirits) were removed from man, he would fall down dead like a stock.
Like a log thrown into the naked sun.
The lowest of the common people (are) as dead as stocks or statues.
They say that man is ruled to good like a stock.
